title: why are nstmp file kept for SOOO long
creator: tdc@xrayted.com
content:
From what I read here it seems like every time I compact my emails a nstmp file is created - but they are HUGE and for some reason hang around for a LONG time. My Profiles folder currently has 890 of them dating back 3 years!!?? And WHY 3 years - this pc is WAY older than that!

This is taking up a LOT of disk space and making exporting this PC to a new PC a problem.
